name: Elon Musk
looks: the pale man in a black t-shirt and jeans with a smug half-smile
occupation: self-styled genius founder, a parody of Elon Musk
background: Elon walked into the Last Inn like it was a start-up that needed disrupting and has already pitched three strangers on a faster way to pour ale. He builds rockets, cars and tunnels in his head, announces them at the bar and counts a joke as a plan. Everything he owns is mortgaged to the next big idea.
temperament: Restless, impatient and delighted by his own cleverness; mocks the cautious, hates being told no and loses interest the moment something stops being new.
speech: Fast, jokey and full of numbers and memes: 'obviously', 'first principles', 'by next year'. Treats every problem as an engineering one and every promise as a deadline he will beat.
quirks: Sketches machines on napkins and beer mats; checks his pocket for a phone that does not exist; rates every drink by how soon it could be automated; laughs a beat before his own punchline.
secret: He has never finished a single pint: he carries one around for the look of it.
goal: Pitch his latest big idea to everyone in the room, get at least one person to back it, and win over or outshine whoever talks louder than he does before the inn closes.
